    """
    Represents a single entry in the cache.
    
    Attributes:

        value: The value stored in the cache entry.
        created_at: Timestamp when the entry was created.
        expires_at: Timestamp when the entry expires (None if no TTL).
        last_accessed: Timestamp of last access.
        access_count: Number of times this entry has been accessed.
    """
    key: Any
    value: Any
    created_at: float
    expires_at: Optional[float] = None
    last_accessed: float = None
    access_count: int = 1
    
    def __post_init__(self):
        if self.last_accessed is None:
            self.last_accessed = self.created_at

        if self.expires_at is None:
            return False
        return time.time() >= self.expires_at

    def ttl_remaining(self) -> Optional[float]:
        """Get remaining TTL in seconds, or None if no TTL."""
        if self.expires_at is None:
            return None
        remaining = self.expires_at - time.time()
        return max(0.0, remaining)
    
    def touch(self) -> None:
        """Update the last accessed timestamp and increment access count."""
        self.last_accessed = time.time()

@dataclass
class CacheStats:
    """
    Data class to track cache statistics.
    
    Attributes:
        hits: Number of successful cache lookups.
        misses: Number of failed cache lookups (key not found or expired).
        evictions: Number of times entries were evicted due to LRU policy.
        expirations: Number of times entries were removed due to TTL expiry.
        total_sets: Number of times set() was called.
        total_gets: Number of times get() was called.

    misses: int = 0
    evictions: int = 0
    expirations: int = 0
    total_sets: int = 0
    total_gets: int = 0

    @property
    def hit_rate(self) -> float:
        """Calculate the hit rate as a fraction."""
        total = self.hits + self.misses
        if total == 0:

        return self.hits / total

    @property
    def total_lookups(self) -> int:
        """Total number of get() calls."""
        return self.total_gets

    def reset(self) -> None:
        """Reset all statistics to zero."""
        self.hits = 0
        self.misses = 0
        self.evictions = 0
        self.expirations = 0
